statements.status_notes: The vulnerability is in oras-go's content/file tar-extraction helper (ensureLinkPath), reached only when a content/file Store extracts an OCI artifact carrying the unpack annotation. This image ships two Go binaries and neither reaches that path. The fleetconfig-controller manager binary does not link oras-go at all (it is absent from that module's graph). The bundled clusteradm binary pulls oras-go only indirectly through helm.sh/helm/v3, whose sole oras usage is its registry client (content/memory plus registry/remote); neither helm, clusteradm, nor the Open Cluster Management libraries import oras-go's content/file package. The vulnerable extraction path is therefore never linked or invoked.
